properties.name: border_style
properties.comment: The panel's border: none, a line, sunken or raised (BorderStyle).

table.description: The panel's border: none, a line, sunken or raised.

prepare: if (incoming != BorderStyle::none && incoming != BorderStyle::line && incoming != BorderStyle::sunken && incoming != BorderStyle::raised) throw std::invalid_argument("Panel border style is invalid");

properties.name: visual_role
properties.comment: The recipe family the panel paints with: window, panel, card, editor (the recessed field ground of the Panel-derived editors such as NumericUpDown and TreeView), or notice (a staged InstrumentRack module).
prepare: if (incoming != ControlVisualRole::window && incoming != ControlVisualRole::panel && incoming != ControlVisualRole::card && incoming != ControlVisualRole::editor && incoming != ControlVisualRole::notice) throw std::invalid_argument("panel visual role must be window, panel, card, editor, or notice");

not_properties.name: background, style
not_properties.reason: optional overrides read through effective getters (background() returns the resolved face, style() the theme's when unset), as ButtonBase's style in M3; an override capability later
